characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is a young man, average height with a lean build. He has light brown hair, often tousled, and a thoughtful expression with bright, curious eyes. His clothing is simple and weathered, a reflection of his humble beginnings. He is often seen carrying a large wooden kneading trough, which becomes a significant object in his journey. His demeanor is earnest and hopeful, and he exudes a quiet determination throughout his adventures.

characters.name: Troldet
characters.description: Troldet is an imposing and fearsome creature, large and hulking in stature, with a rugged, monstrous appearance. Its skin is rough, a stony gray, and it has long, tangled hair resembling wild vines. The troll's facial features are exaggerated, with a broad nose and sharp, predatory eyes. It is often seen in its cave or by the lake, watching over its silver ducks and valuable possessions, including the golden harp and patchwork bedspread.

characters.name: Staldmesteren
characters.description: Staldmesteren is a middle-aged man, of average build, typically dressed in practical clothing suitable for someone who works closely with horses. He has a rugged appearance, with graying hair and a skeptical look. He is often seen around the royal stables, carrying out his duties with experience and authority.

characters.name: Kongens Datter
characters.description: Kongens Datter, or the princess, is a young woman of noble bearing, with long, flowing blonde hair and a serene expression. She wears elegant royal garments adorned with detailed embroidery and rich colors. Her demeanor is gentle yet regal, reflecting her royal upbringing. She appears in a festive gown during her wedding celebration with Askeladden.

characters.name: Troldets Datter
characters.description: Troldets Datter is a smaller version of the troll, with a similar rugged, stony appearance. She has wild, tangled hair and sharp features but shows a more subdued presence compared to the troll. She is often seen assisting with household tasks in the troll's cave.
